alt_text: Cover: why don't all your lights go out?
Home lighting is parallel: a drawing of a kitchen branch lit and a bedroom branch with an open switch, labelled as a simple model (homes use the mains supply).
Torch is series: batteries end to end, why a torch won't light, and how a doorbell push switch works.
Stay safe and save power: metal core and plastic coat in wires, safety rules, and switching off at the socket.
